title: Fault Sentinel: proactive error aggregation, causal tagging, and remediation flowboard
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a ‘Fault Sentinel’ service and Flowboard that aggregates inference errors across traces, metrics, and logs, applies a lightweight failure taxonomy, and surfaces causal tags and remediation steps for oncall and SRE analysts. Deliverables include tracing hook schema changes, a metrics/log enrichment pipeline, a compact failure taxonomy mapping (timeouts, overload, model errors, transport codes), and an interactive dashboard with SLO-correlated views and suggested runbook actions.
acceptance_criteria: Tracing hooks emit a standardized failure_reason tag and failure_stage tag for all inference RPC spans
Metrics pipeline emits a 1m cardinality-limited error series per failure_reason and host pool
Log enrichment adds canonical failure_reason and trace_id to error logs with sampling controls
Flowboard dashboard shows top-10 failure reasons for last 6h, grouped by tenant, model, and route
SLO correlation: for any SLO breach, Flowboard highlights dominant failure reasons and suggests one of three remediation actions (retry, scale, failover)
Oncall runbook links are generated per failure_reason and surfaced in the dashboard
End-to-end test demonstrating a simulated overload event correctly classifies as OVERLOAD and triggers suggested remediation
implementation_steps: Design tracing hook schema: failure_reason, failure_stage, model_variant, queue_time_ms; review with tracing owners
Instrument runtime RPC layer to populate hook fields for timeouts, cancellations, overload backpressure, model decode errors, and 4xx/5xx transport codes
Update metrics exporter to roll up failure_reason into a low-cardinality metric set and tag pools/regions
Create log enrichment transform in pipeline (vector/logproc) to attach canonical tags and ensure trace_id propagation
Build Flowboard: backend query endpoints for aggregated failure slices and SLO overlays; frontend heatmap and causal link panel
Add runbook authoring UI hooks and map runbooks to failure_reason keys
Add sampling and privacy knobs for tenant-sensitive traces and ensure PII-free error tags
Smoke tests: synthetic trace generator producing representative errors; verify pipeline and dashboard UI
notes: 2026-02-11 - Aisha: Kickoff meeting; scoped MVP as aggregation + dashboard + runbook mapping. Agreed taxonomy draft: TIMEOUT, OVERLOAD, MODEL_ERROR, TRANSIENT_NETWORK, AUTHZ, CLIENT_BAD_REQUEST, INFRA_RETRYABLE, UNKNOWN.
2026-02-18 - Diego: Prototype tracing hook PR opened (github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/4021) implementing failure_reason and failure_stage; initial comments from Riley on tag naming conventions.
2026-02-25 - Riley Chen (tracing): Recommended changing failure_stage to {ingest, routing, execution, encode, transport} to keep consistent with span names. Updated PR with mapping table.

2026-03-02 - Diego: Metrics exporter patch (github.com/redwood/observability/pull/118) adds low-cardinality metrics: inference_failure_total{reason,pool,model}, inference_failure_latency_bucket. Waiting on infra rollout.

2026-03-05 - Ops: Metric retention concern — default 90d may blow up if we tag by model + route + reason. Decided to limit to model_semantic (coarse model family) for 30d and keep detail for 7d. Added design trade-off notes.
2026-03-09 - UX review: Wireframes for Flowboard show causal-links panel and 'Suggested actions' column. PM says include an explicit 'Acknowledge & create incident' button.

2026-03-12 - Diego: End-to-end test harness added to staging; simulated overload event classified as OVERLOAD and dashboard suggested 'scale pool' remediation. Marking dependency ENG-121009 for SLO mapping work.
Post-release follow-ups: Add automated regression alerts when classification drift exceeds 10% vs. sampled manual annotations. Capture as new ticket after MVP.

Design trade-offs: We intentionally keep failure_reason coarse to avoid cardinality explosions; trade-off is less precise root cause but faster aggregation and lower cost. Documented in confluence link below.
review_feedback: Riley Chen: Ensure tag names are stable; avoid freeform reason strings. Use enumerated reason codes.
Elena Novak (SRE): Add a suppression window for noisy tenants to avoid alert storms; we will surface but not auto-escalate for first 10m.
Marcus Lee (Product): Flowboard must surface cost impact estimate when suggesting 'scale' to help SREs decide.
Privacy: Legal confirmed that failure_reason values are low-risk if they do not include user-provided strings. Keep that constraint enforced in enrichment pipeline.
